scientific_limitations: Applies to one-dimensional driftless Brownian motion with independent Poisson resetting to iid locations on a specified compact positive interval.
Orders path maxima only above both the initial position and every reset location.
Does not imply stochastic ordering of full trajectories or absorption times, nor a fixed-time maximum law.
Potential unindexed convex-order or general killed-process antecedents remain a publication-priority risk.
No independent scientific audit or experimental validation has been performed.
title: Sharp excursion-risk envelope at fixed Brownian search time under distributed resetting
